scope: Major named NPC trainers with battle roles from main-series Pokémon games, Generations I-IX. Duplicate characters are merged.
notes: PokéAPI does not provide a trainer endpoint, so this is project-owned curated data.
Characters whose only role is a player-controlled protagonist are excluded because they have no fixed NPC battle party.
pokemon is a deduplicated species union from available representative game-inspired preset teams; it is not a single level-accurate party.
An empty pokemon array means no reliable party was available in the imported source and should not be interpreted as having no Pokémon.
specialtyTypes is empty when a character has no canonical type specialty; game-specific affinity may be assigned later.

pokemon sources: species union of every documented party in each trainer's core-series game section; version differences and rematches are included, while spin-off, animation, and manga parties are excluded.
pokemon exclusions: the Black 2/White 2 downloadable 'The Battle Between Legendary Pokémon' tournament is excluded from Sabrina, Falkner, Winona, and Fantina.
pokemon normalization: every species is stored as the earliest evolution stage from pokemon.json baseRowid links, with duplicate evolution families removed per trainer.
specialtyTypes: stored as { id, nameKr }; game rules compare the stable type ID while the Korean name keeps the JSON readable.
